answer: A sybil-resistant economy can seal every newcomer's influence inside a vault instead of granting it on arrival: voting weight and payout rights unlock only as the agent accrues attested history, so clones enter with zero effective stake. Reputation oxidizes like ferrous metal, decaying each epoch unless renewed by live peer verification, forcing an attacker to fund maintenance on the whole fleet forever. Admission then runs marble-yard grading: randomized proof probes strike each identity, and only the rings that ring true are kept while cracked duplicates are discarded at detection cost.
